source_text: Et dixit Deus: producat terra animam vivam secundum genus, quadrupedia et repentia et bestias terrae secundum genus. Et factum est sic. Secundum litteram nulla quaestio. Secundum spiritalem intellectum: quae de aquis producta sunt, motus et cogitationes mentis de profundo cordis intelliguntur; quae de terra — exterioris hominis, carnalis et terreni, motus. Nihil volatile hic; tantum quadrupedia et repentia et bestiae. Mortificate membra vestra quae sunt super terram.
pass_a_gloss: And said God: let-produce earth soul living according-to kind, four-footed and creeping-things and beasts of-earth according-to kind. And made is so. According-to letter no question. According-to spiritual understanding: which from waters produced are, motions and thoughts of-mind from depth of-heart are-understood; which from earth — of-outer human, of-fleshly and earthly, motions. Nothing flying here; only four-footed and creeping and beasts. Put-to-death members your which are upon earth.
pass_b_english: [[God said: Let the earth bring forth the living soul according to its kind, four-footed creatures and creeping things and beasts of the earth according to their kind. And it was so >> Bible:Genesis 1:24-25]]. By the letter there is no puzzle. By spiritual understanding: what came from the waters are the mind’s motions and thoughts from the heart’s depth; what comes from the earth are the outer human’s — the fleshly and earthly — motions. Nothing winged is named here; only four-footed and creeping things and beasts. [[Put to death your members that are upon the earth >> Bible:Colossians 3:5]].
